d: Voluminous, curly crimson hair falls to the shoulders, topped with a black beret adorned with small colorful patches. The eyes are a bright golden-yellow with a playful, confident expression. The face appears to be in the late teens or early twenties with a mature, spirited demeanor and a slender build. The outfit consists of a white lace-up crop top, a long, oversized burnt-orange coat, and a mismatched, patchwork brown and blue skirt; accessories include a black choker with a red bow, a beaded necklace, a single brown leather thigh strap, and black mid-calf boots.
